MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 7

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

6. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

9. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. B — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
